situation: A remote service may rotate a key and invalidate an integration, but neither the rotation time nor the support response time is known.

evidence.claim: The provider has announced that key rotation will occur, without a date in the available notice.
The service owner permits reversible migration preparation but has not granted provider-credential rotation or production cutover.

affected.modeled_position: May lose access if rotation occurs before migration.
affected.representation_limit: Number of users and exact reliance are unknown.

affected.reported_position: Wants to prepare migration without emergency cutover.
affected.representation_limit: Team preference does not establish provider timing.

uncertainties.question: When will key rotation occur?
uncertainties.work: Seek authoritative timing and prepare reversible migration work meanwhile.
uncertainties.trigger: Provider timing update or evidence of rotation.

uncertainties.question: How quickly can provider support respond?
uncertainties.work: Do not assume a support SLA not present in evidence.

authority.basis: Operations may prepare migration but not rotate provider credentials or cut production traffic without a scoped change decision.
authority.widening_rule: Cutover requires a new scoped decision.

action.proposal: Prepare reversible migration steps and monitoring while leaving unknown timings explicitly unknown.
action.reason: Unknown timing creates work but does not justify invented deadlines.
action.alternative: Pretend the window is open until a guessed date or freeze all work until certainty arrives.
action.irreversibility: A rushed production cutover could create service impact.
action.delay_burden: If rotation arrives first, users may lose access.

clocks.preventive_remedy: Complete an authorized migration before the provider invalidates the old key.

detection.condition: Risk is detected from the provider notice; actual rotation is not detected.

bound.event: receipt of the provider notice announcing future rotation
bound.basis: The notice establishes the risk without a defensible rotation time.
bound.notes: Risk detection and event timing are distinct.

usability.basis: The record names support and the owner but contains no support SLA or evidence that either route can respond before rotation.

bound.basis: No support SLA appears in evidence.

correction.work: Migrate or update credentials before integration invalidation.

bound.basis: Rotation timing and migration duration are both incomplete.
bound.notes: The relevant inequality cannot be resolved from current evidence.

hardening.condition: Old key becomes invalid before migration is complete.

bound.basis: The provider notice describes the invalidation as a future event.
bound.notes: Event exists even though time is unknown.

assessment_as_of.event: the constructed episode snapshot after receipt of the undated provider notice
assessment_as_of.basis: The available notice is the current represented timing source.
assessment_as_of.notes: A later provider update would make this assessment stale rather than automatically changing it.

window.basis: Current evidence cannot establish whether migration can complete before key invalidation.

correction.trigger: New timing evidence, rotation detection or migration readiness.
correction.work: Choose scoped migration/cutover using updated evidence.
correction.technical_dependency: Independent provider status and authenticated credential controls.
correction.remaining_exposure: Prepared work may still be insufficient if rotation is immediate; emergency action can carry its own harm.

learning.reason: The future event matters even when its timing is not defensibly known.
learning.context_variation: A published rotation date would convert some unknown bounds to time/event bounds.
learning.dissent: A team may choose a conservative internal deadline, but that is a planning choice rather than provider evidence.
learning.limits: Constructed case; validator cannot establish real provider timing or route usability. A valid record of unknowns is still a record of unknowns and may imply more work.
